3.3.1.v: The affixes उण् and the rest with the force of the present and with a sense simply appellative are attached diversely.

3.3.2.v: The उणादि affixes are seen also attached with the force of the past time.

3.3.3.v: The words गामि etc. are valid forms having the sense of the future time.

3.3.4.v: The affix लट् (Present Tense) comes after a root with the force of futurity when it has in construction with it the particles यावत् and पुरा।

3.3.5.v: The affix लट् (Present Tense) is optionally used after a root with the force of the futurity when it has in construction with it the adverbs कदा and कर्हि।

3.3.6.v: When the word किम् or its derivatives are in construction with a verb, the affix लट् (Present Tense) is used optionally after a root, in denoting future time, provided that the sentences expresses a desire of gaining on the part of the speaker.

3.3.7.v: And when the success, that would accrue to another by fulfilling the desire of the speaker, is indicated in a sentence, the present tense may optionally be used with the force of the futurity.

3.3.8.v: The affix लट् (Present Tense) is optionally used with the force of futurity after that root, which is in a conditional sentence, is the condition precedent for the action indicated by another verb having the sense of the imperative mood.

3.3.9.v: The लट् (Present Tense) or the लिङ् (Potential) is used under similar conditions in denoting futurity, when the future time is future by a मूहूर्त (= 48 minutes).

3.3.10.v: The affixes तुमुन् and ण्वुल् are placed after a verbal root with the force of the future when the word in construction therewith is another verb, denoting an action performed for the sake of the (future) action.

3.3.11.v: And the affixes that are ordained to come after a root with the force of denoting the mere action of the verb, such as धञ् etc. -- लोहितादिडाज्भ्यः क्यष् [[3.1.3]], have also the force of the future, when the word in construction therewith is another verb denoting an action performed for the sake of the future action.

3.3.12.v: The affix अण् comes after a root with the force of the future when the word in construction with it is in the Accusative -2nd case and when the action is performed for the sake of another action.

3.3.13.v: The affix लृट् (2nd Future) is used after a verb in the remaining cases where futurity pure and simple is indicated and also where there is construction with it another verb denoting an action performed for the sake of the future action.
3.3.13.e: When a helper action is done for doing a main action in future (For example, 'going to school  for studying'), the लृट्लकार can be used to denote the main action ('studying' in this example). In addition, the लृट्लकार can also be used to indicate a general action to be done in future, even when no helper action is indicated.
3.3.13.sa: भविष्यकालं द्योतयितुम् क्रियार्थायाम् क्रियायाम्, तद्भिन्नायाम् च क्रियायाम् लृट्-लकारः भवति ।
3.3.13.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.3.14.v: The affixes called सत् i.e. शतृ and शानच् are optionally the substitutes of लृट् (2nd Future).

3.3.15.v: The affix लुट् (1st Future) comes after a verbal root in the sense of what will happen but not in the course of the current day.
3.3.15.e: लुट्-लकार is used to indicate actions that will happen tomorrow or later.
3.3.15.sa: अनद्यतन-भविष्यकालं द्योतयितुम् धातोः परः लुट्-लकारः प्रयुज्यते ।
3.3.15.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.3.16.v: The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. पद् 'to pace' 2. रुज् 'to pain 3. विश् 'to enter' 4. स्पृश् 'to touch'.

3.3.17.v: The affix घञ् comes after the verb शृ 'to move' when the agent is permanently fixed.

3.3.18.v: The affix घञ् comes after a root when mere action is denoted.

3.3.19.v: The affix घञ् comes after a root when the sense is that of an appellative, the word being related to the verb from which its name is deduced, but not as agent.

3.3.20.v: The affix घञ् comes after all roots when the word so formed is the name of a measure.

3.3.21.v: The affix घञ् comes after the root इङ् 'to study'.

3.3.22.v: The affix घञ् comes after the verb रू 'to roar' when it has an उपसर्ग in composition with it.

3.3.23.v: The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. यु 'to join' 2. द्रु 'to run' 3. दु 'to burn' when in composition with the preposition सम्।

3.3.24.v: The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. शृ 'to go to' 2. नी 'to lead' 3. भू 'to be' when not in composition with an उपसर्ग ।

3.3.25.v: The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. क्षु 'to sneeze' 2. श्रु 'to move and hear' when the preposition वि is in composition.

3.3.26.v: The affix घञ् comes after the verb नी 'to lead' when the prepositions अव and उत् are in composition.

3.3.27.v: The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. द्रु 'to run' 2. स्तु 'to praise' 3. श्रु 'to move and hear' when the word in composition is प्र।

3.3.28.v: The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. पू 'to purify' 2. लू 'to cut' when निर् and अभि are respectively in composition.

3.3.29.v: The affix घञ् comes after the root गॄ when the उपसर्ग-s उत् and नि are in composition.

3.3.30.v: The affix घञ् comes after the verb कॄ when the prepositions उत् and नि are in composition and when the sense of the verb relates to grain.

3.3.31.v: The affix घञ् comes after the verb स्तु 'to praise' when it is preceded by the उपसर्ग सम् and the word refers to sacrificial subjects.

3.3.32.v: The affix घञ् comes after the verb स्तॄ 'to cover' when preceded by the preposition प्र ; provided that the word so formed does not refer to sacrifice.

3.3.33.v: The affix घञ् comes after the verb स्तॄ 'to cover' when the preposition वि is in composition with it when the sense is that of extension and when such spreading does not refer to words.

3.3.34.v: The affix घञ् comes after the verb स्तॄ 'to cover' with the उपसर्ग वि when the word so formed is the name of a metre.

3.3.35.v: The affix घञ् comes after the verb ग्रह् 'to seize' when the preposition उत् is in composition.

3.3.36.v: The affix घञ् comes after the verb ग्रह् 'to seize' when in composition with preposition सम् when the sense of the root refers to fist.

3.3.37.v: The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. नी 'to lead' 2. इ 'to go' when the prepositions परि and नि respectively in composition with them and when the words so formed respectively mean 'a game' and 'propriety or arrangement or law'.

3.3.38.v: The affix घञ् comes after the root इ 'to go' in composition with the word परि when the sense is that of following in regular succession.

3.3.39.v: The affix घञ् comes after the root सी 'to lie down' when the prepositions वि and उप are in composition with it and when the sense of the word so formed is that of 'regular succession'.

3.3.40.v: The affix घञ् comes after the root चि 'to collect' when the sense expressed is that of taking by hand provided it does not refer to stealing.

3.3.41.v: The affix घञ् comes after the roots चि 'to collect' and क is the substitute of the initial च in these senses viz. - 1. 'a dwelling' 2. 'a fire on the funeral pile' 3. 'the body' 4. 'collection'.

3.3.42.v: The affix घञ् comes after the roots चि 'to collect' and क is the substitute of the initial च in the sense of 'a multitude or assembly' (of living beings possessing some common characteristics) but not merely a confused crowd of men.

3.3.43.v: The affix णच् comes after a root in denoting reciprocity of action and the word so formed is in the feminine gender.

3.3.44.v: The affix इनुण् comes after a root in denoting condition when co-extensiveness is meant.

3.3.45.v: The affix घञ् comes after the root ग्रह् 'to seize' in composition with अव and नि when malediction is meant.

3.3.46.v: The affix घञ् comes after the root ग्रह् 'to seize' when the word प्र is in composition and the sense denoted is the desire of acquisition.

3.3.47.v: The affix घञ् comes after the root ग्रह् 'to seize' in composition with परि when it relates to sacrificial subjects.

3.3.48.v: The affix घञ् comes after the verb वृ preceded by नि when the sense is that of grain.

3.3.49.v: The affix घञ् comes after the verbs 1. श्रि 2. यु 'to join' 3. पू 'to purify' 4. द्रु 'to run' when the preposition उत् is in composition.

3.3.50.v: The affix घञ् is optionally used after the verbs 1. रू 'to roar' 2. प्लु 'to float' when the preposition अङ् is in composition.

3.3.51.v: The affix घञ् is optionally used after the root ग्रह् 'to seize' when the word अव is in composition, the sense being 'withholding the rain'.

3.3.52.v: The affix घञ् is optionally used after the root ग्रह् 'to seize' in composition with प्र when the word so formed relates to commerce.

3.3.53.v: The affix घञ् is optionally used after the root ग्रह् 'to seize' in composition with प्र when the word so formed means 'a rein'.

3.3.54.v: The affix घञ् is optionally used after the verb वृ 'to choose' when प्र is in composition and the word so formed means 'a sort of covering'.

3.3.55.v: The affix घञ् is optionally used after the verb भू 'to be', the word परि being in construction and the sense of the word so formed being 'disregard'.

3.3.56.v: The affix अच् comes after a root ending in इ or ई (when mere action is denoted or when the sense is that of an appellative, the word being related to the verb from which its name is deduced, but not as an agent).

3.3.57.v: After a root ending in long ॠ , short उ or long ऊ , there is the affix अप्।

3.3.58.v: The affix अप् comes after the verbs 1. ग्रह् 'to seize' 2. वृ 'to choose' 3. दृ 4. निश्चि 5. गम् 'to go'.

3.3.59.v: The affix अप् comes after the verb अद् 'to eat' when an उपसर्ग is in composition.

3.3.60.v: And The affix ण as well as अप् come after the verb अद् 'to eat' when the उपसर्ग नि is in composition.

3.3.61.v: The affix अप् comes after the verbs 1. व्यध् 'to hurt or to pierce' 2. जप् 'to mutter' when no उपसर्ग is in composition with them.

3.3.62.v: The affix अप् comes optionally after the verbs 1. स्वन् 2. हस् when no उपसर्ग is in composition with them.

3.3.63.v: And The affix अप् comes optionally after the verb यम् 'to surround' when the उपसर्ग -s सम् , उप , नि and वि are in composition ; or even when it is without उपसर्ग -less.

3.3.64.v: The affix अप् comes optionally after the verbs 1. गद् 'to speak' 2. नद् 'to sound' 3. पठ् 'to read' 4. स्वन् 'to sound' when the उपसर्ग नि is in composition with them.

3.3.65.v: The affix अप् comes optionally after the verb क्वन् 'to jingle' when नि is in composition with it, as well as when it is without any उपसर्ग or when 'flute' is meant.

3.3.66.v: The affix अप् comes Invariably after the verb पण् 'to barter' when the sense is that of 'measure'.

3.3.67.v: The affix अप् comes after the verb मद् when not in composition with an उपसर्ग ।

3.3.68.v: The words प्रमद and सम्मद are irregularly formed, meaning 'joy'.

3.3.69.v: The affix अप् comes after the verb अज् 'to go' when the preposition सम् and उत् are in composition and the word so formed refers to beasts.

3.3.70.v: The word ग्लह is irregularly formed when the sense of the root refers to gambling.

3.3.71.v: The affix अप् comes after the verb श्रि 'to flow' in the sense of impregnating (the covering of cows etc.).

3.3.72.v: The affix अप् comes after the verb ह्वे 'to call' when the preposition नि , अभि , उप and वि are in composition with it and its semi-vowel is changed into the corresponding vowel.

3.3.73.v: The affix अप् comes after the verb ह्वे 'to call' when the word in composition is the उपसर्ग आण् and the semi-vowel of the root is changed into its corresponding vowel, when the word so formed means 'battle'.

3.3.74.v: The word आहाव is irregularly formed when meaning 'a trough'.

3.3.75.v: The affix अप् comes after the verb ह्वे 'to call' and there is the change of the semi-vowel to its corresponding vowel, when the root is without an उपसर्ग and mere action is denoted.

3.3.76.v: The affix अप् comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when without an उपसर्ग , in the sense of mere action and वध is the substitute of हन् 'to kill' before this affix.

3.3.77.v: The affix अप् comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when the word so formed means 'solidity' and घन् is the substitute.

3.3.78.v: The verb हन् preceded by the word अन्तर् takes the affix अप् and घन् is the substitute of the word हन् when the word so formed means 'a country'.

3.3.79.v: The words प्रघणः and प्रघाण are irregularly formed meaning 'a portion of a dwelling house'.

3.3.80.v: The word उद्घन is irregularly formed in the sense of 'bench'.

3.3.81.v: The word अपघन is irregularly formed meaning 'a member of the body'.

3.3.82.v: The affix अप् comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when the words अयस् , वि or द्रु are in composition with it, when the word so formed is related to the verb as an instrument and घन् is the substitute.

3.3.83.v: The affix क also comes after a root हन् 'to kill' when स्तम्ब 'a clump' is the word in composition and the relation of the word so formed to the verb is that of the instrument.

3.3.84.v: The affix क also comes after a root हन् 'to kill' when the उपसर्ग परि is in composition and the relation between the word so formed and the verb is that of an instrument and घ replaces हन् ।

3.3.85.v: The word उपघ्न is irregularly formed meaning 'an inclined place for leaning or support'.

3.3.86.v: The words संघ and उद्घ are irregularly formed in the sense of 'a collection' and 'a praise' respectively.

3.3.87.v: The word निघ is irregularly formed in the sense of 'as high as broad'.

3.3.88.v: The affix क्त्रि comes after the verb which has an indicatory डु when denoting mere action etc.

3.3.89.v: After that verb that has an indicatory टु , the affix अथुच् comes with the force of denoting mere action etc.

3.3.90.v: After the verbs 1. यज् 'to worship' 2. याच् 'to ask for' 3. यत् 'to strive' 4. विच्छ् 'to shine' 5. प्रच्छ् 'to ask' 6. रक्ष् 'to preserve', comes the affix नङ् with the force of denoting mere action etc.

3.3.91.v: The affix नन् comes under similar circumstances after the verb स्वप् 'to sleep'.

3.3.92.v: The affix कि comes under similar circumstances after a घु verb -- दाधा घ्वदाप् [[1.1.20]] when an उपसर्ग is in composition with it.

3.3.93.v: The affix कि comes after a घु verb -- दाधा घ्वदाप् [[1.1.20]] when a word in the Accusative -2nd case is in composition with it and when the relation of the word so formed to its verb, is that of 'location.

3.3.94.v: To express an action etc. by a word in the feminine gender, the affix क्तिन् is added to the root.

3.3.95.v: After the roots 1. स्था 'to stand' 2. गा 'to sing' 3. पा 'to drink' 4. पच् 'to cook', the affix क्तिन् is used when a word in the feminine gender denoting a 'mere action' is to be expressed.

3.3.96.v: In the मन्त्र literature, क्तिन् acutely accented comes after the following roots, forming words in feminine gender, denoting a 'mere action' 1. वृष् 'to rain' 2. इष् 'to wish 3. पच् 'to cook' 4. मन् 'to think' 5. विद् 'to know' 6. भू 'to be' 7. वि 'to go, to consume' 8. रा 'to give'.

3.3.97.v: And these words viz. 1. ऊति 'preserving sport' 2. यूति 'joining' 3. जूति 'velocity' 4. साति 'destruction' 5. हेति 'a weapon' 6. कीर्ति 'fame', are anomalous forms, acutely accented (उदात्त).

3.3.98.v: The affix क्यप् comes after a roots 1. व्रज 'to go' 2. यज् 'to worship' acutely accented (उदात्त) in forming a word in the feminine denoting action.

3.3.99.v: The affix क्यप् comes after the following verbs in forming a word in the feminine denoting an 'appellative 'and is acutely accented (उदात्त) viz. 1. समज 2. निषद 3. निपत 4. मन 5. विद 6. षुञ् 7. शीङ् 8. भृञ् 9. इण्

3.3.100.v: And after the root कृ comes the affix श in forming a feminine as well as the affix क्यप्।

3.3.102.v: After the verbs that end in an affix, there is the affix अ, the word being feminine.

3.3.103.v: The affix अ comes after a verb which has a prosodially heavy vowel and ends in a consonant when the word to be formed is feminine.

3.3.104.v: The affix अण् comes after those verbs that have an indicatory षि and after भिद् when the word to be formed is feminine.

3.3.105.v: The affix अण् as well as the affix युच् come after the following verbs, forming feminine words - 1. चिन्त् 'to think' 2. पूज् 'to worship' 3. कथ् 'to narrate' 4. कुम्ब् 'to cover' 5. चर्च् 'to learn'

3.3.106.v: The affix अण् comes after those verbs which end in long आ when an उपसर्ग is in composition and when the word to be formed is feminine.

3.3.107.v: After verbs ending in णि and after आस् 'to sit' and श्रन्थ् 'to loose', there is the affix युच् when the word to be formed is feminine.

3.3.108.v: The affix ण्वुल् comes diversely after verbs when the word to be formed is feminine noun, being the name of 'diseases'.

3.3.109.v: The affix ण्वुल् comes after the verbal roots, when the word to be formed is an appellative.

3.3.110.v: And the affix इञ् comes optionally after a root when a question and answer is expressed (as well as ण्वुल् and other affixes ordained by other rules).

3.3.111.v: The affix ण्वुच् comes optionally after a root in the sense of succession, merit, debt or production.

3.3.112.v: The affix अनि comes after a verb when the particle नञ् is in composition with it and the sense implied is that of 'cursing'.

3.3.113.v: The affixes called कृत्य -- कृत्याः प्राङ् ण्वुलः [[3.1.95]], and the affix ल्युट् , are diversely applicable and have other senses than those taught before.

3.3.114.v: The affix क्त is added to the root when action is expressed, the word being in the neuter gender.

3.3.115.v: The affix ल्युट् is added to the root when the name of an action is expressed, in the neuter gender.

3.3.116.v: The affix ल्युट् is added to a root when the name of an action is expressed, in the neuter gender provided that the verb has in construction with it, such a word in the Accusative -2nd case, as indicates the thing, from the contact with which, there arises a pleasant sensation corporally to the agent.

3.3.117.v: The affix ल्युट् is added to a root when the relation of the word so formed to the verb is that of an instrument or location.

3.3.118.v: The affix घ generally comes in the sense of an instrument or location after a root, when the word to be formed is a name and is in the masculine gender.

3.3.119.v: And the words 1. गोचर 2. संचर 3. वह 4. व्रज 5. व्यज 6. आपण 7. निगम are anomalous.

3.3.120.v: The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. तॄ 'to cross' 2. स्तॄ 'to spread, to cover', when the उपसर्ग अव is in composition with them and when the word so formed is an appellative related to the verb either as an instrument or as a location.

3.3.121.v: And after a verb ending in a consonant, comes the affix घञ् (when the word to be formed is masculine and related to the verb as an instrument or a location and thereby the palatal is changed into guttural).

3.3.122.v: And the words 1. अध्याय 2. न्याय 3. उद्याव 4. संहार 5. आधारा 6. आवयाः are anomalous.

3.3.123.v: The word उदङ्क is anomalous when the sense of the root refers to subjects other than 'water'.

3.3.124.v: The word आनाय is irregularly formed when the meaning is 'a net'.

3.3.125.v: The affix घ as well as घञ् come after the verb खन् 'to dig' when the word to be formed is an appellative related to the verb as an instrument or location.

3.3.126.v: In the sense of 'hard and difficult' or 'light and easy' the affix खल् is added to a verb when ईषद् and दुर् and सु are combined with it as उपपद-s.

3.3.127.v: The affix खल् comes after the verbs भू 'to be' and कृ when the उपपद-s in composition with them are 'agent' and 'object' respectively, preceded by the words ईषद् etc. in combination with them, meaning 'hard or light'.

3.3.128.v: The affix युच् comes after the roots ending in long आ (when ईषद् and दुर् and सु are combined as उपपद-sūtras, in the sense of easily or with difficulty).

3.3.129.v: The affix युच् comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the roots having the sense of 'to go' when the word ईषद् etc. meaning 'lightly' or 'with difficulty' are in composition with such verbs.

3.3.130.v: The affix युच् is seen to come number the छन्दस् (Vedas) after other verbs also, than those meaning 'to go'

3.3.131.v: The affixes which are used when the sense is that of present time, may, optionally in like manner, be used when the sense is that of past or future time not remote from the present.

3.3.132.v: The affixes which are used when the sense is that of past time or of the present time, may, optionally, in like manner, be used after a root in denoting future time when hope is expressed.

3.3.133.v: When the word क्षिप्र 'quickly' or its synonym is in construction with the verb, the future affix लृट् (2nd Future) is used after the root when 'hope' is expressed in a conditional form.

3.3.134.v: The affix of the Potential is used in denoting Futurity after a root, when the उपपद in composition with it is a word expressing 'hope'.

3.3.135.v: When constant continuance of action or a near Past or Future is meant, the Past and Future are not denoted as taught in अनद्यतने लङ् [[3.2.111]] and अनद्यतने लुट् [[3.3.15]], through the Imperfect and the II Future, but through the Aorist and the First Future.

3.3.136.v: The Futurity is not expressed, as taught in अनद्यतने लुट् [[3.3.15]] through the II Future, but through the I Future, when a statement is made of a limit on this (अवर) side of another place.

3.3.137.v: The II Future is used instead of the I Future in denoting Future time not belonging to the current day when the word अवर is used together with a word expressing division of time, but not when it is a word giving the sense of 'day' or 'night'.

3.3.138.v: Optionally so, when a declaration is made with regard to that side of a limit of time.

3.3.139.v: Where there is a reason for affixing लिङ् (Benedictive) the affix ऌङ् (Conditional Future) is used in the Future tense when the non-completion of the action is to be understood.
3.3.139.e: In the context of future, if the cause-effect scenario is being described with an implication that the action did not happen, the लृङ्लकारः is used.
3.3.139.sa: भविष्यति अर्थे, लिङ्लकारस्य यत् निमित्तम् तस्मिन्नेव निमित्ते, क्रियातिपत्तिं दर्शयितुम् धातोः लृङ्लकारः भवति ।
3.3.139.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.3.140.v: And (where there is a reason for affixing लिङ् (Benedictive) , the affix ऌङ् (Conditional Future) is to be used, when the non-completion of the action is to be understood) if the sense is that of past time.

3.3.141.v: From this point up to sūtra उताप्योः समर्थयोर्लिङ् [[3.3.152]] (the whole of the following sentence is to be taken as exerting a governing the influence on the sūtras that follow; where there is a reason for affix लिङ् (Benedictive) , the ऌङ् (Conditional Future) may be) optionally (used in denoting the past time, when the non-completion of the action is to be understood).

3.3.142.v: The affix लट् (Present Tense) is used after a root when it has in composition with it the wordsअपि or जातु , the sense implied by the sentence being that of 'censure'.

3.3.143.v: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) as well as लट् (Present Tense) is optionally used after a root when the word कथम् is in construction with it and censure is implied.

3.3.144.v: The affixes लिङ् (Benedictive) and लृट् (I Future) come after a verb when the interrogative words like किम् etc. are in composition with it and censure is implied.

3.3.145.v: When it is to be expressed that somebody hold that something is not likely to take place or is not to be tolerated, the Potential and the I Future are used, even without the Interrogative Pronoun.

3.3.146.v: The affix लृट् (I Future) is used after a root when the words किंकिल or those having the sense of अस्ति 'he is' are in construction with it (when the action is not likely to occur, or is not to be tolerated).

3.3.147.v: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes after a root, the words जातु and यत् being in construction with it, when the sense is that the action is not believed to be likely or is not to be tolerated.

3.3.148.v: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes after a root in all tenses when the words यच्च and यत्र are in composition with it, provided that censure is implied.

3.3.149.v: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes in all tenses when the words यच्च and यत्र are in composition with it, provided that censure is implied.

3.3.150.v: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes in all tenses when used with the words यच्च and यत्र and the sense implied is that of 'wonder'.

3.3.151.v: In all the cases when 'wonder' is implied by word other than यच्च and यत्र , the affix लृट् (I Future) is used after a root, except when the word यदि is used.

3.3.152.v: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes after a verb in all tenses when the words उत and अपि , both having the same meaning, are in composition.

3.3.153.v: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes after a root, in expressing or making known of a wish, except when the word कच्चित् is in composition with it.

3.3.154.v: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) is used after a root, when the expectation (of a person or thing being able or competent to do or suffer the action denoted by the verb is implied (or expressed by any other word used along with them) than 'alarm'.

3.3.155.v: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) is optionally used after a verb when it has another verb which expresses 'expectation' in construction with it, but not so when the word यत् is used.

3.3.156.v: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) is optionally used after those verbs which express the condition and its consequence.

3.3.157.v: The affixes लिङ् (Benedictive) and लोट् (Imperative) are used after a root when another verb having the same sense of 'wishing' is in construction with it.

3.3.158.v: The affix तुमुन् comes after a verb when another verb meaning 'to wish' is in construction, provided that the agent of both the verbs is the same.

3.3.159.v: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) is used after a verb when the verbs meaning 'to wish' are in construction with it and the agent of both the verbs is the same.

3.3.160.v: After roots meaning 'to wish' the लिङ् (Benedictive) is optionally used denoting the present time.

3.3.161.v: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes after a verb when the agent either 1. commands 2. invites 3. permits 4. politely expresses a wish 6. asks questions or 7. prays.
3.3.161.e: लिङ्लकार  can be used to indicate विधि (= order) , निमन्त्रण ( = an invitation that cannot be rejected), आमन्त्रण  (= an invitation that can be rejected), अधीष्ट (= Ask something with respect, often in exchange of money or something else), सम्प्रश्न (= A question about doing or not doing something) and प्रार्थना (= request).
3.3.161.sa: विधिः, निमन्त्रणम्, आमन्त्रणम्, अधीष्टम्, सम्प्रश्नः, प्रार्थना - एतेषु अर्थेषु  धातोः परः आद्युदात्तः लिङ्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
3.3.161.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.3.162.v: The affix लोट् (Imperative) is used after a root in the sense of commanding etc.
3.3.162.e: लोट्लकार can be used to indicate विधि (= order) , निमन्त्रण ( = an invitation that cannot be rejected), आमन्त्रण (= an invitation that can be rejected), अधीष्ट (= Ask something with respect, often in exchange of money or something else), सम्प्रश्न (= A question about doing or not doing something) and प्रार्थना (= request).
3.3.162.sa: विधिः, निमन्त्रणम्, आमन्त्रणम्, अधीष्टम्, सम्प्रश्नः, प्रार्थना - एतेषु अर्थेषु धातोः परः आद्युदात्तः लोट् -प्रत्ययः भवति ।
3.3.162.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.3.163.v: The affixes called कृत्य and the affix लोट् (Imperative) come also after verbs, in the sense of direction, granting permission and proper (particular) time.

3.3.164.v: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) (as well as कृत्य and लोट् (Imperative) ) is used (under similar circumstances in the sense of 1. direction 2. permission etc.) when the time is future by a मुहूर्त (48 minutes or an Indian hour); (or the Potential may be used as well when it signifies 'at this very moment').

3.3.165.v: The affix लोट् (Imperative) comes after a verb when the word स्म is in composition (when the sense is that of 'direction', permission etc.) and referring to time by a मुहूर्त (48 minutes or an Indian hour).

3.3.166.v: And when 'wish' is meant ( the लोट् (Imperative) may be used when the word स्म is in composition with the verb.

3.3.167.v: The affix तुमुन् comes after a root when the words 1. काल 2. समय 3. वेला (all meaning time) are in composition.

3.3.168.v: The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes after a root when the word यद् is in composition and the words 1. काल 2. समय 3. वेला occur in construction.

3.3.169.v: The affixes कृत्य and the affix तृच are added to a root when fitness as regards the agent is implied (as well as in the affix लिङ् (Benedictive) ).

3.3.170.v: The affix णिनि is added to the root in denoting agent, showing that there is some 'necessity' or 'indebtedness' or 'obligation' on the part of the agent in connection with the action denoted by the verb.

3.3.171.v: The affixes called कृत्य also come after a root when the sense to be indicated is that of 'necessity' or 'obligation'.

3.3.172.v: And the affix लिङ् (Benedictive) as well as the कृत्य affixes come after a verb when the sense is that of 'capability'.

3.3.173.v: The affixes लिङ् (Benedictive) and लोट् (Imperative) come after a verb by which 'benediction' is intended.
3.3.173.e: लिङ्लकार and लोट्लकार are used to express the desire of something that cannot be easily attained.
3.3.173.sa: अप्राप्तस्य इच्छां दर्शयितुम् लिङ्लकारः लोट्लकारः च प्रयुज्येते ।
3.3.173.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.3.174.v: The affixes क्तिच् and क्त are used after a root when benediction is intended, provided that the whole word so formed is an appellative.

3.3.175.v: The affixes लुङ् (Aorist) comes after a verb when the word माण् is used in connection with it.
3.3.175.e: In presence of the अव्यय माङ्, लुङ्लकारः is used.
3.3.175.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.3.176.v: When the word मान is followed by स्म the affix लङ् (Imperfect Tense) as well as लुङ् (Aorist) may be used after a verbal root.
3.3.176.e: When माङ् is followed by स्म, the verb लुङ्लकार or लङ्लकार is used.
3.3.176.sa: 'स्म' यस्मात् परः अस्ति तादृशस्य माङ् अव्ययस्य विषये लुङ्लकारस्य लङ्लकारस्य वा प्रयोगः भवति ।
3.3.176.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation
